name: teda/donate
title: TEDA Donate
description: The full donation page: amount selector, impact tiers, project cards, trust strip, recent updates and other ways to give. Phase 1 routes the gift offline (mobile money, bank, prefilled WhatsApp/email); phase 2 turns on live payments from the Customizer with no redesign.

lead.default: Every contribution goes directly into education, health, climate action, and youth leadership across the Teso sub-region.

ugx_t1_desc.default: Scholastic materials for one student for a term — exercise books, pens, and a mathematical set.

ugx_t2_desc.default: Keeps one vulnerable student in school for a term through TEDA’s education support fund.

ugx_t3_desc.default: Sponsors one young entrepreneur through the full business skills and financial literacy bootcamp.

ugx_t4_desc.default: Funds a community tree-planting drive with one school — 200 seedlings, tools, and training.

ugx_t5_desc.default: Delivers a district youth leadership training for 40 young people, including venue, materials, and travel.
